name: kanborg-connect
description: Operate KanBorg from Claude Desktop or Claude Code through its paired local MCP connection, and let KanBorg wake this Claude session through a bundled channel: discover projects, manage settings, coordinate work and hand off control, gated by live app capabilities.

kanborg_connection_id.title: KanBorg connection ID
kanborg_connection_id.description: The KANBORG_COORDINATOR_CLIENT value from KanBorg → Coordinators for this Claude connection. Not a secret. Enables local watching so KanBorg events wake this session.
